result.rationale: In sendAddGuestsEmails, `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` compares raw strings; the handler filters guests against `booking.attendees` with `guest === attendee.email` (also case-sensitive) and neither normalizes case. Emails are case-insensitive in practice, so a guest stored as 'User@Example.com' but submitted as 'user@example.com' would slip past the dedup filter and then get AttendeeScheduledEmail instead of AttendeeAddGuestsEmail. Mechanism is verifiable from the diff's code.
